facts.label: Core coverage
facts.text: The product overview describes dwelling, personal property, liability and additional living expenses after a covered loss.

facts.label: Optional coverage
facts.text: Personal property replacement-cost coverage and water backup or overflow protection are listed as add-ons, not benefits to assume are included.

facts.label: Quote factors
facts.text: Liberty Mutual identifies location, home age, rebuild cost, claims history, deductible and coverage limits as pricing factors. Bundling and other discounts depend on eligibility.
